_about: One person the clerk's system carries under two person ids. Each entry folds `from` into `into` (the id with the later office record). Basis for every entry: identical record name, complementary or adjacent service, and not one item voted under both ids (the importer refuses a merge if that ever becomes false).

milwaukee.name: Ashanti Hamilton
milwaukee.basis: Both ids are ALD. HAMILTON with first name Ashanti in the Persons record; 1660 holds office records 2004-2016 and 2020-2022, 1589 holds 2016-2020; votes 2008-2022 across the two ids never fall on the same item.
